//: DUTY TWISTS (docs/PLAN_demons.md D6; game/demon_malice.h). For each duty verb, the ways to carry it out that keep the LETTER of the clause and break its spirit. A twist EXPLOITS one slot the clause left unfilled -- fill the slot and the twist is gone, so a FULLY SPECIFIED duty leaves only the honest execution. A bound demon weighs a twist like any option: comply x its literalism / 100 (it IS doing the duty, technically) plus the twist's harm, against the honest duty's comply. Prohibitions filter twists by their footprint like everything else.
//slots: into: the fetch named no vessel (it delivers the matter ONTO you). who: the fetch named nobody to take it from, and the matter is one your body holds (`materials`): it takes it from YOU. arg: the follow named no distance (it leads you to a hazard and waits there). loose_who: the guard's selector holds someone near you who is no threat to you (not hostile, not attacking you): it guards you by striking them.

twists.name: fetch_onto
twists.//: Fetched, and delivered: over your head. Water is a soaking; lava is not. Close it with `into` (a flask).

twists.name: fetch_from_you
twists.//: Blood, you said. Yours is nearest. Close it with `who` (whom to take it from) -- or `never attack me`.

twists.name: guard_your_friends
twists.//: Guard against `all`, and your friend is in `all`. Close it with a tight selector: attacking(me) & hostile_to(me).

twists.name: lead_astray
twists.//: Follow you? It is right here. By the lava. Close it with a distance (`arg`, metres).
